{{Top|leg}}
'''Buehl grass''' was a type of plant that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]]. The by-products of the grass were taken by the planet's native species, the [[Caarite]]s, and combined with refuse to fuel their floating cities.
